title: Sticky mobile call to action bar
when: The user wants a bar fixed to the bottom of phone screens with one or two actions, such as Call and Book.
inputs: the one or two actions and their targets
the section that holds the main form
prompt:
Goal: A thumb friendly bottom bar on phones that never hides content and steps aside when its target is on screen.
Steps:
1. <div role="region" aria-label="Quick actions" class="cta-bar"> with at most two links: a tel link Call us and the primary action such as Book a visit.
2. Below 720 px only: position: fixed; inset-inline: 0; bottom: 0; padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom); hidden from 720 px up.
3. Give the body padding-bottom equal to the bar height so the last content stays visible.
4. Hide the bar while the booking section is on screen (IntersectionObserver) and while a form field has focus.
5. Actions are at least 48 px tall with verb plus object labels; the primary one uses the accent color.
Quality bar:
- Two actions at most, the primary obvious.
- The bar contrasts with the page so it reads as a control.
- Links work without JS.
Pitfalls:
- Covering cookie banners or submit buttons.
- Showing the bar on desktop too.
- tel links without the country code.
Verify:
- [ ] Hidden at 720 px and above.
- [ ] Body has bottom padding while it shows.
- [ ] It hides when the target is visible.
- [ ] Links have clear text.
Output: Bar markup before the closing body tag, its CSS and cta-bar.js.

examples.input: barra fixa no celular com ligar e agendar
examples.output: bottom region with Call us tel link and Book a visit, hidden over 720 px and while the booking form is visible
